title: Derivation — structural placeholder
description: Attributable relation between referenced and resulting material; derivation is not itself adoption, succession, or a constitutional change classification.
$comment: Annotation-only placeholder: accepts every instance; no conformance or constitutional effect is established.

referenced_material.description: Exact predecessor material to which derivation is attributed.

resulting_material.description: Exact resulting material, distinct from its referent.

attribution.description: Supported derivation relation, without transfer of Source or ownership of later formations.

changes.description: Recoverable additions, removals, or transformations of material.

scope.description: Bounds of the derivation claim and supporting evidence.

constitutional_classification.description: Separately supported Article 17 classification if constitutional change is claimed; otherwise no classification is established by derivation alone.

change_basis.description: Independent valid local basis, carry account, and effective boundary for any claimed constitutional change.

effect_ceiling.description: Effects not established by copying, adaptation of material, ancestry, or reference.
